# TRIO Rehabilitation & Wellness Solutions

> A comprehensive rehabilitation clinic in Boerne, Texas offering physical, occupational, and speech therapy with specialized programs for neurological conditions including Parkinson's disease.

TRIO Rehabilitation & Wellness Solutions is a therapy clinic serving the Boerne and San Antonio areas with evidence-based treatments using methodologies like LSVT BIG, VitalStim, and Pilates-based therapy. The clinic specializes in orthopedic rehabilitation, neurological conditions, stroke recovery, hand therapy, and movement disorders.

## Key Topics

- Physical Therapy
- Occupational Therapy
- Speech Therapy
- Parkinson's Disease
- RISE Program
- LSVT BIG
- Stroke Recovery
- Hand Therapy

- Pilates-Based Therapy
- Movement Disorders
- Boerne, Texas
- Patient Resources
- Wellness Center

## Core Therapy Services

- [Therapy Services](https://www.triorehab.com/therapy-services): TRIO therapy services: physical, occupational, speech therapy
- [Physical Therapy](https://www.triorehab.com/physical-therapy): Physical therapy for seniors, orthopedic, neurological conditions
- [Occupational Therapy](https://www.triorehab.com/occupational-therapy): Occupational therapy including hand therapy and stroke recovery
- [Speech Therapy](https://www.triorehab.com/speech-therapy): Speech therapy for swallowing, Parkinson's, voice disorders
- [Pilates-Based Physical Therapy](https://triorehab.com/pilates): Pilates-based physical therapy for injury recovery and wellness

## Specialized Programs

- [RISE Program](https://www.triorehab.com/rise): RISE wellness program for Parkinson's disease movement therapy
- [6 Reasons to Join RISE](https://www.triorehab.com/6-reasons-to-join-rise): RISE program benefits and membership reasons for Parkinson's care
- [Parkinson's Disease Workshop](https://www.triorehab.com/parkinsonsworkshop): Parkinson's disease workshop event October 2025 by TRIO
